guarantees.claim: When clear_i or use_i is asserted, we_d is forced to all-zero; else when armed_q is set and we_i has any bit set, we_d is driven with we_i; otherwise, we_d equals we_q OR we_i.
When clear_i or use_i is asserted, armed_d is forced to 0; else when armed_q is set and we_i has any bit set, armed_d is forced to 0; otherwise, armed_d equals armed_q OR arm_i.

assumptions.claim: clear_i and use_i must not be asserted during a write cycle that uses the armed mechanism (when armed_q=1 and we_i is non-zero), else we_d is forced to zero and armed_d cleared, causing a lost write.
assumptions.cond: armed_q=1 and we_i has any bit set
assumptions.risk: loss of a critical configuration or key write, potentially causing security state inconsistency

assumptions.claim: arm_i must be held asserted until it is captured (armed_q becomes 1) when neither clear_i nor use_i is active, otherwise the arm request may be missed, preventing the module from becoming armed.
assumptions.risk: the module never arms, blocking subsequent write operations

uncertain_points.claim: When armed_q=1 and we_i has some but not all bits set, we_d passes the partial we_i value to the write strobe, allowing partial register writes. Is the design intent to allow partial writes, or should we_i be all-one to ensure atomic write?
uncertain_points.risk: partial configuration updates may lead to inconsistent control register state

uncertain_points.claim: armed_d is a combinational function of we_i: if we_i is glitchy or delayed relative to clock, a transient non-zero pulse while armed_q=1 will cause armed_d to go low, potentially being sampled and disarming the module prematurely, even if we_i returns to zero before the cycle.
uncertain_points.cond: armed_q=1 and we_i sees a glitch
uncertain_points.risk: spurious disarm may cause a write operation to be missed or split, compromising operation integrity

uncertain_points.claim: The meaning and source of use_i are not apparent from this chunk; it forces clear of armed state. Need to confirm that use_i assertion cannot be maliciously triggered and that it correctly indicates operation completion without leaving a stale armed state.
uncertain_points.risk: incorrect use_i could prematurely disarm or interfere with the security mechanism
